tytul: Green wild garlic oil for the refrigerator, used within days (UGA method)
wstep: This card uses the UGA Extension method for oil with non-acidified fresh herbs, here wild garlic leaves: the oil is heated to 180 °F (82 °C) before the leaves are added, and the oil is kept in the refrigerator and thrown away 4 days after it was made, or frozen.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to BfR, young wild garlic leaves resemble those of the poisonous lily of the valley and the very poisonous autumn crocus; when in doubt, it is better not to eat them.
Home-made oils with non-acidified garlic or herbs must never be stored at room temperature.
Keep this oil in the refrigerator and throw it away 4 days after you made it, or freeze it.
NCHFP gives the same limit for garlic in oil: make it fresh and keep it in the refrigerator at 40 °F (4.4 °C) or lower for no more than 4 days.

akapity: Vegetables and herbs in oil meet the conditions for botulinum toxin production: spores can be present, oil keeps oxygen out, and the pH is above 4.6.
You cannot tell from the look, smell or taste of the oil whether botulism is a risk.

It covers fresh wild garlic leaves added to heated oil; the acidification method was developed only for garlic, basil, oregano and rosemary and must not be used for other herbs, so it is not used here.
Using dried leaves instead does not ensure a safe oil: without a laboratory measurement you cannot know whether dried herbs are dry enough.
According to AGES, wild garlic is also confused with spotted arum, Solomon’s seal and wild tulips.
JarAtlas rule: if you are not sure that every leaf is wild garlic, do not use the leaves.
Make only as much oil as you will use within 4 days.
Wash the glass container thoroughly and boil it for 10 minutes.
Choose good-quality leaves, wash them thoroughly and pat them dry.
AGES advises washing wild garlic leaves one by one, thoroughly, under hot running water before eating or freezing them.
Heat the oil to 180 °F (82 °C), checking it with a kitchen thermometer, and only then add the leaves.
Put the oil with the leaves into the sterilized container, close it and keep it in the refrigerator.
Throw the oil away 4 days after you made it.
Alternatively, freeze the oil until you are ready to use it.
